review_locator: The Signaling Role of CD40 Ligand in Platelet Biology and in Platelet Component Transfusion, PMCID:PMC4284712; CD40L and Its Receptors in Atherothrombosis—An Update, PMCID:PMC5477003
primary_title: Soluble CD40 ligand induces beta3 integrin tyrosine phosphorylation and triggers platelet activation by outside-in signaling
decision_basis: The platelet CD40L review cites the primary study showing soluble CD40L binds the platelet alphaIIbbeta3 integrin through its KGD motif and triggers beta3 tyrosine phosphorylation, fibrinogen binding, microparticle formation, platelet spreading, and thrombus formation.
limitations_preserved: Preserve soluble/membrane CD40L and KGD motif, alphaIIbbeta3 outside-in signaling, platelet-specific context, CD40 independence in the cited assay, and no SCI inference.
